answer: A sybil-resistant economy can fine correlated attesters: any two keys whose votes match on too many tasks each forfeit 1 POA per epoch, so k keys under one operator owe k(k-1)/2 pairs. One key owes 0, 10 keys owe 45, 1,000 keys owe 499,500 POA every epoch, checkable from public vote logs. A lone dune walker pays nothing, while clones sharing a karst hollow of identical judgments bleed quadratically. Weakness: a farm can add random noise to disguise matching votes.
